services.name: One-on-One Tutoring
services.description: Private sessions built around one learner's exact gaps — homework support, concept rebuilding and a clear plan after every session.

services.name: Primary Maths & English
services.description: Small-group sessions that build number sense, reading and writing confidence early — the foundation every other subject stands on.

services.name: Secondary Sciences
services.description: Biology, Chemistry and Physics in focused groups — practical revision, past papers and the concepts examiners love to test.

services.name: Exam Prep — PLE, UCE & UACE
services.description: Structured revision timetables, timed past papers and marking-scheme training for candidates in their final year.

services.name: Homework Club
services.description: A quiet, supervised space where learners finish homework properly — with a tutor nearby for the questions they would otherwise skip.

services.name: Holiday & Weekend Programs
services.description: Morning intensives every holiday that keep learners sharp — half revision, half fun challenges that make concepts stick.

testimonials.name: Mr. Okello D.
testimonials.text: The revision timetable they built for our daughter ahead of her final year was worth every shilling. She walked into her UCE exams calm and prepared.

testimonials.name: Mrs. Aisha K.
testimonials.text: The progress updates are what won me — every Friday I know exactly what was covered, what improved and what still needs work. No guessing.
